approval: TADA2B uses the day-specific unlabelled-cell gate, carried over unchanged from the D4 decision (user, 2026-10-21: "I guess lets just treat the TADA2B different.") so that D4 and D14 use the same primary gates.
description: In these backgrounds the primary reporter-negative gate is the day-specific unlabelled-cell gate (mCherry cut at the valley between GFP-negative unlabelled cells and mCherry-positive cells, found on D0 and on this timepoint). All other backgrounds keep the standard gate (eGFP < 6 and mCherry < 6.5). Standard-gate values are retained for every well as a sensitivity.
